source.title: Unable to restore item using item restoration webpage — Heart of Wind (Mythic)
source.author: Advil-3400117

notes: Evidence-quality correction of midnight-20261106-101401, not a new independent cohort. The player reported trying to restore one Heart of Wind (Mythic) after disenchanting it and having 1 rank-1 Dawn Crystal in inventory after several other disenchantments; later possessed both crystal ranks and restoration succeeded. Inventory count and restoration costs do NOT establish that this specific operation produced 1 crystal, a rank-1 crystal, or a material hit. Thus prior castsWithDrop=1, totalQuantity=1, histogram 1:1 and measured sourceKind=study are unsupported; remove them, retain only an item-variant eligibility reference. At-cast ilvl/bonus, skill, specialization, output item ID/rank, and completed-operation log are unknown. The catalog's Mythic+ preview is not an at-cast itemLink. Replaces original source row using estimator's append-only replacements mechanism; do not count as an additional observation.
